gaps.title: Half-pixel hairlines
gaps.note: Polaris 0.66px (`border-width-0165`) #8a8a8a on fields, selects and checkboxes (Chrome rounds the field borders to 1px at DPR 1)

gaps.title: Sidebar nav row height apart from the control height

gaps.title: Inset page panel with no edge while cards and overlays keep a 1px line
gaps.note: the Shopify Admin's #f1f1f1 page panel sits beside the #ebebeb sidebar and under the black top bar with no edge, while its cards, menus, tooltips and the modal draw a 1px ring (`rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)`, #e2e2e2 over the page) under soft shadows (signed in)
gaps.standin: `surfaceEdge: line` also rims the sidebar inset (`panel` edge 1px, oklab L 0.90); `bevel` leaves the panel clear but drops the card, menu and dialog lines (3 rows off)

gaps.title: Weights between the standard steps
gaps.note: Polaris's live Admin (now on Polaris web components, signed in) body, field values, field labels and menu rows at 450, buttons, tabs and nav rows at 550, the current nav row and page and card titles at 600 (Polaris React set 650 and 700)
gaps.standin: 400 / 500 / 600 (neutral links at 500), so Polaris's 450 and 550 measure 50 light (its 600 steps match with `navItemWeight: medium-semibold`)

gaps.title: Fields filled with the raised surface, hairline edge, no shadow
gaps.note: Polaris #fdfdfd fields and selects behind a 0.66px #8a8a8a edge, on white cards and the #f1f1f1 page alike
gaps.standin: on Polaris it reads as #f0f1f1, ΔE 0.037)

gaps.title: Heading weight apart from the title style
